A '''planet''' was the site of a [[Battle of unidentified planet (Kenobi and Skywalker)|battle]] early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] clashed with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]].
